title: CBIC Notifies India–New Zealand FTA Rules of Origin, Effective 20 October 2026
content:
# CBIC Notifies India–New Zealand FTA Rules of Origin, Effective 20 October 2026

Ek important update hai! The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) ne India aur New Zealand ke beech Free Trade Agreement (FTA) ke under Rules of Origin notify kar diye hain. This is a crucial step for businesses involved in trade between the two countries.

Here are the key details:

*   **What's New:** The CBIC has issued the "Customs Tariff (Determination of Origin of Goods under the Free Trade Agreement between India and New Zealand) Rules, 2026." These rules define how goods will qualify as originating from India or New Zealand to avail preferential customs duty benefits under the FTA.
*   **Notification Details:** This update comes via Notification No. 82/2026-Customs (N.T.) dated 12 October 2026.
*   **Effective Date:** Ye naye rules 20 October 2026 se effective ho jayenge.
*   **Why it Matters:** The rules will provide a clear legal framework for determining the origin of goods, covering aspects like wholly obtained goods, product-specific rules, and methods for calculating Qualifying Value Content (QVC). This aims to streamline trade and ensure proper utilization of the FTA's benefits. Businesses need to ensure their documentation and processes align with these new rules for claiming preferential tariffs.
